one_line: This ad demonstrates how lip augmentation alters overall facial proportions using precise visual measurements and a physical interactive test.

hook.what_happens: A split-screen slider shows a woman's face before and after a subtle lip augmentation.
hook.why_it_works: Creates instant visual curiosity by showing how a single change alters the entire face.

shots.description: Portrait of a blonde woman with a split-screen slider showing lip augmentation and facial measurement lines.
A per-pixel difference heatmap highlighting the changed areas of the face in yellow.
Split-screen comparison focusing on the nose-to-lip gap distance.
A second subject (Asian woman) demonstrating the same lip augmentation effect.
Split-screen comparison focusing on the lip-to-chin distance.
Side-by-side comparison of the original and edited face.
Text instructions prompting the viewer to try a physical test.
Call to action with a search bar mockup for Refina AI.

onscreen_text.text: Look how much of her changed.
The lower third is read from here
Lips are not just a feature.
They are what the lower third is measured from
Here is every pixel that moved.
Almost all of it is the mouth.
Almost none of it is anywhere else.
NOSE BASE TO LIP EDGE, MEASURED
Thin lips make it long. Full lips, short.
You are reading it against a new mouth.
Roll your lips inward and hold.
If you are about to change something there, see it on your own face first.

transcript.text: One photo, one region edited. Only her mouth was edited. Look how much of her changed. Lips are not just a feature. They are what the lower third is measured from.
Here is every pixel that moved. Almost all of it is the mouth. Almost none of it is anywhere else.
One. The gap under her nose. Thin lips make it long. Full lips, short. Same nose.
Two. Another face, same edit. Same result.
Three. Her chin looks stronger. It is the same chin. You are reading it against a new mouth.
None of this means fuller is better. It means lips are load-bearing.
Test it yourself. Roll your lips inward and hold. Watch your chin arrive.
If you are about to change something there, see it on your own face first. A preview, not a promise. Search Refina AI.

narrative_arc: Introduce the concept of 'load-bearing' facial features.
Provide per-pixel proof that only the lips were modified.
Explain the geometric relationship between lips, nose, and chin.
Validate the findings with a second subject.
Engage the viewer with a physical self-test.
Introduce the app as the solution to preview these changes safely.

cta.what: Search 'Refina AI' to preview facial changes on your own face.

subjects: Blonde woman (Subject 1, demonstrating lip augmentation effects)
Asian woman (Subject 2, demonstrating the same effects)
what_makes_it_work: Clinical, objective tone that avoids typical beauty ad hype.
Interactive physical prompt that makes the viewer feel the anatomical connection instantly.
Clear, data-driven visual evidence that builds high credibility.
